title: Confirm button colour and the message lines' weight and colour
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. Open a deactivation confirmation and a reactivation confirmation from both entry points; read the confirm button colour and Cancel.
  2. Read the weight/colour of the "Existing records that use..." line and the "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • In every confirmation the confirm button is red for a deactivation and blue for a reactivation (from either entry point), with Cancel as plain text to its left.
  • The "Existing records that use..." line is medium weight wherever it appears; the "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." line is grey; every other line is regular weight in the default text colour.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R28: “In every confirmation the confirm button is red for a deactivation and blue for a reactivation, from either entry point. Cancel is plain text to its left.”
  • S10-R29: “The "Existing records that use ..." line is set in medium weight wherever it appears. The "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." line is set in grey. Every other line is regular weight in the default text color.”
